stem: In a code, PEN is written as QFO. How is CUP written in the same code?
hints: Compare each letter of PEN with the letter in the same place in QFO.
P becomes Q. Which way did P move in the alphabet, and by how many letters?
Each letter moves forward by the same number of places. Move each letter of CUP the same way.

solution.methodName: Compare each letter with its code

steps.action: Line up the word and its code: P with Q, E with F, N with O.
steps.why: A letter code changes each letter by a rule. Comparing them one pair at a time shows the rule.

steps.action: Each letter moves forward by 1: P (16) to Q (17), E (5) to F (6), N (14) to O (15). The rule is +1.
Apply +1 to each letter of CUP: C becomes D, U becomes V, P becomes Q.
The code for CUP is DVQ.

trapNotes.BTO: BTO moves each letter back by 1. In the example, P became Q, which is a move forward.
trapNotes.EWR: EWR moves each letter forward by 2. P to Q is only 1 step.
trapNotes.DVP: DVP leaves the last letter unchanged. Every letter in the code moves forward by 1, so P becomes Q.
